BBTTCC Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Menhirkin heritage: Sedimentary.

“The old stones remember what the new ones are pretending to be.”

Menhirkin (Sedimentary). You are laid-down stone. Every year of every century of every epoch stacked on top of the year before, pressed into a single body. Other Menhirkin are events. You are a record. The ground under the bunker may be a grandparent to other Menhirkin. It’s your diary.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Menhirkin).
  • Size. Medium.
  • Movement. 30 feet walking.
  • Lineage Lean. Menhirkin does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Mind in fiction and through Tier powers.

Menhirkin Core: The Land Stood Up

Shared across all Menhirkin heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Stone Soul. You count as Large for carry, shove, and grapple despite your Medium frame. You have advantage on checks to resist being forcibly moved.
  • Hex Recognition. Once per scene, while you are on a natural surface you are directly touching, you may whisper a single question about the place. The GM answers with one true thing the land knows.
  • Slow to Wear. You have advantage on Body checks against exhaustion, long-duration physical wear, forced marches, climate exposure, and sustained labor. You do not tire the way softer things tire.
  • Heavy Presence. Your weight and settledness are perceptible. Creatures within 10 feet of you know you are there even if they cannot see you; you have disadvantage on Intrigue (Stealth) checks unless you are on or in stone.

Sedimentary Traits

  • Old Layer Resilience. At creation, pick one damage type: poison, qliphothic, or energy with a single flavor of your choice. You have resistance to that damage. The land under you is old. Old land has outlasted a lot.
  • Layer Reading. You can touch any worked surface older than a century and tell, without a check, its approximate age, the most recent meaningful thing that happened there, and whether anyone you can currently see has also touched it.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / BBTTCC)

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Intrigue OP and +1 Economy OP at campaign start.
  • Hex Synergy. In Ruins / Archaeological / Old-Record hexes, the first archival or recon operation your faction runs per Turn costs 1 fewer OP.
  • Strata Witness. Once per Strategic Turn, while on a hex with recorded history, your faction may ask the GM one true thing about a past faction that held it. Useful on a contested claim.
⟁ Per-Use Ability — Hex Recognition
Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Action  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
